title: dactylorhiza × kerneriorum nothosubsp. lillsundica
intro: Dactylorhiza × kerneriorum nothosubsp. lillsundica, commonly known as the Lillsund orchid, is a hybrid plant species within the genus Dactylorhiza. It is a type of orchid that is known for its unique characteristics and therapeutic properties. The Lillsund orchid has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe and calm the body. Its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as vasodilation and sedation.
